name: GeoJSON
description: Fetches a GeoJSON FeatureCollection from a configurable URL (with optional query parameters, headers, timeout and retries) on a schedule and posts the Point, LineString, Polygon and expanded Multi/GeometryCollection features to the map.

permissions.description: Submits the fetched GeoJSON features as CoT features to CloudTAK

schedule.description: Fetches the configured GeoJSON URL for updated features on a schedule.
